Review snapshot-recovery specification candidate snapshot-recovery-spec-r14@r14 in specification mode. No implementation exists.

- Verify every finding in .omp/artifacts/snapshot-recovery-fresh-plan/cr-r13-raw.md is closed by exact r14 text: (1) retention name parsing must filter per family so a snapshot pass cannot count or unlink prompts.corrupt-*, with both-family oracles; (2) reservation fs.ErrExist must advance to the next candidate while only other create errors are fatal, mirrored in AC2-8(b-res)/AC1-9(b); (3) R7's no-record rule scoped to recovery/retention records so the Durable-loader record survives; (4) fatal-first + corrupt-second ordering specified with an oracle; (5) AC1-6 asserts the full retention record shape and pinned message/remediation; (6) T2 carries wiring.go:486-491 and startup_failure.go:26-33 anchors and quotes the classification strings; LOWs: actual ticket state in 9.7, numeric FIFO/no-block mechanism, five-reason admission table, LoadPrompts/SavePrompts negatives, satisfiable eviction phrasing, empty-string env case.
- Scan for new blocking defects introduced by the revision; verify no R/AC/T id or envelope change and that the 6.1 file set matches section 6.
- Report each finding with class, severity, confidence, anchor, consequence, minimal fix. Do not claim unrun tests or diagnostics.

# Output contract
Installed CodeReviewer format ending with exactly '### Recommendation' then APPROVE or REQUEST CHANGES and nothing after it. APPROVE only when no blocking-class high-confidence finding remains. Do not modify any file.
